blocks.text: NEW YORK — LeBron James won’t play Monday night in Brooklyn, sitting out the second half of the Philadelphia 76ers’ back-to-back. James moved into third place on the NBA’s career assists list on Sunday, when he had 15 points and 11 assists in the 76ers’ 131-124 victory over Indiana. The NBA’s career scoring leader passed Jason Kidd and now has 12,092 assists. READ: LeBron James moves to 3rd on NBA career assist list James, who will turn 42 next month, was ruled out Monday for low back/sciatica management.
